question: Should #102054 land as a broad durable queue-owned media handoff after a conflict-resolving rebase, or should it be narrowed to typed Codex result transfer first?
rationale: The typed result-byte transfer is supported by upstream Codex, but the branch now changes a broad delivery ownership path and is conflicting with current main, so maintainers need to choose the acceptable merge shape and proof bar.

options.title: Rebase and prove the broad handoff
options.body: Resolve conflicts, preserve current-main queue recovery fields, and rerun focused outbound/gateway/Codex tests plus real channel proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to typed result transfer
options.body: Split out durable queue-media receipt work if maintainers want the Codex contract fix landed with less message-delivery surface area.

options.title: Pause for a clean replacement
options.body: Keep this PR as source work if conflict resolution becomes mostly branch reconstruction and ask for a smaller replacement branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase and prove the broad handoff
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, preserve current-main queue recovery fields, and rerun focused outbound/gateway/Codex tests plus real channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined history on Codex app-server projection and outbound delivery ownership decisions.
